newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares start mixed, Bel-20 .BFX up.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares start mixed, Bel-20 .BFX up.

text.p: 0810 GMT - Belgian shares mixed at start though Bel-20 index nudges higher into record territory, up 3.95 points, or 0.16 pct, at 2,492.02 points. Market seen toppish at 2,500 points.
* Chemicals and drugs maker UCB, an index heavyweight, up 1,300 francs at 122,300 francs as analysts continue to be positive on firm's long-term prospects.
* Royale Belge down 75 francs at 11,225 francs despite article in Wall Street Journal highlighting speculative sale talk surrounding insurer.
